DL-01.checked: layout_guard faults plus pairwise text/tile box collisions and off-canvas boxes, at every size; deliberate stacks are not collisions: a textless tile with another shape of its own diagram, or a focus card (overlay, pop-over) over body content (never over a title or chrome)

DL-02.checked: rendered text px ≥ params.min_px_1920 (20) at ≥ 1920 wide, else ≥ params.min_px_1280 (15); labels (uppercase and tracked ≥ .05em, or a .cite/.quote-from source line) ≥ params.min_label_px_1920 (18) / params.min_label_px_1280 (12)

DL-09.checked: bar, agenda and notes button keep their box (±1 px) between consecutive slides

DL-10.checked: every connector ends ≥ 0.5 units clear of both tiles; markers orient=auto with refY centred

DP-01.checked: WCAG 2 ratio of each visible text run against its composited background (4.5, large 3), unrounded; never-text palette roles used as text fail; text softened (blurred) beneath a focus layer is skipped

DP-02.checked: unsoftened connector strokes ≥ 3:1 against the diagram's composited background

DP-03.checked: no hex/rgb()/hsl()/oklch()/lab()/lch() colour literal outside the PALETTE block

DP-05.missing: needs a second shipped palette to swap to; only one palette ships (add the check with the second theme)

DS-01.checked: ≤ 2 primary font families, each declared in --sys-font-*; every size on the --sys-type-*/--comp-* size scale (diagram text: rendered size on the scale, or its SVG size on a --comp-*-floor)

DS-03.checked: ambient layer only on lead or build-free, diagram-free slides; no other looping animation; reduced motion stops all drift

DS-07.checked: no visible link (slide or notes callout) in the browser's default link colours

AR-01.checked: network blocked: no external request, no failed resource, no console error; no external reference in the source

AR-03.checked: keyboard (→ then ←) reaches every slide × step in order both ways; each state renders the same both ways and via goto

AR-04.checked: no <style>, <script>, style= or on*= inside slide sections

AR-05.checked: one non-empty, unique title per slide; no DOM-later block sits above an earlier one in the same column

AR-06.checked: every img has alt; every slide svg/role=img has an accessible name (aria-label, labelledby or <title>)

PX-01.checked: pptx/scripts/check.py: every scene word (markers and generated quotes aside) is in a text frame

PX-02.checked: pptx/scripts/check.py: every slide uses a master layout; its title is in the title placeholder, nowhere else

PX-03.checked: pptx/scripts/check.py: theme colours/fonts equal the scene palette and fonts; no literal RGB equal to a theme colour and no explicit theme font name in slides

PX-04.checked: pptx/scripts/check.py: one click per HTML step (steps the report drops by policy aside), each click animating that step's elements; Morph only on the slide a camera move starts

PX-05.checked: pptx/scripts/check.py: every native/approximated style effect is present on its shape (outer shadow, soft edge, alpha); every lost or undeclared one is listed in the report and absent

PX-07.checked: pptx/scripts/check.py: every slide titled, titles unique (Morph continuations aside), title first in reading order after decorative shapes, alt text on pictures

PX-08.checked: pptx/scripts/check.py: every diagram part is a shape named by its element id (or an SVG picture with PNG)

PX-09.checked: pptx/scripts/check.py: speaker notes equal the slide's reader note text
